lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Macal, stop. You keep saying 'I led the project.' Led how? Give me the situation, the task, the action.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sure. Picture this. Deadline moved up, two people out sick. I split the work, and we shipped it early.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Wait. That was... actually good. Say it again, slower.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hold on. Did Tarek just admit Macal was good? Somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَمَاعَة، أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُمْ فِي Yalla Fluent!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النَّهَارْدَة، طَارِق وَمَكَال بِيِتَدَرَّبُوا عَلَى مُقَابَلَة شُغْل... وَالْحِوَارْ بَيْنَهُمْ... بَقَى صَرَاحَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: رَكِّزُوا مَعَايَا عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات... الأُولَى: 'Give me the situation.'
lines.direction: clear, teaching, slow on the English

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبَعْدَهَا: 'Can you clarify that?'... وَأَخِيرًا، وَهِيَ الْمُهِمَّة: 'Let me walk you through it.'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نِسْمَعْ سَوَا... وَبُصُّوا كُوَيِّس، لِأَنَّ الدَّرْسْ الْيَوْمْ دَهْ... هُوَ الْمِفْتَاحْ!
lines.direction: energetic, ready to play the scene

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Okay. Again. But this time, imagine I am the interviewer. I will not smile. I will not help you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Fine. Give me the situation. Dune and Co., last quarter. Two designers out sick, and the client moved the deadline up by ten days.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Good. And your task?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My task was simple to say, hard to do: keep the team calm and still ship on time. So let me walk you through it.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Wait, wait. You said 'the team was calm.' But who kept them calm? You? Or luck?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Me. I split the work into three tracks, paired the juniors with seniors, and I handled the client calls myself. We shipped two days early.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, that one landed. Tarek, be honest. Would you hire him?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Honestly? Yes. But the ending was weak. You need a result, not a feeling. Numbers. What changed because of you?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Fair. The result: we kept the client, and they gave us a second contract worth forty thousand dirhams.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Better. One more thing. When they ask something you do not understand, do not guess. Ask. Say: 'Can you clarify that?'

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Can you clarify that? Okay, I like that. I live here since two years, and nobody taught me this in a real way.
lines.direction: light, then the planted mistake slips out naturally

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: There. Right there. 'Since two years.' We will fix that after. But Macal, your English is sharper now. I will say it once.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Twice. You said it twice. Say it a third time and I am recording it for the whole office.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَمَاعَة، تَعَالُوا نْفَكِّكْ التَّلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات دُولْ... وَاحْدَة وَاحْدَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلْ وَاحْدَة: 'Give me the situation.' يَعْنِي... احْكِيلي الْوَقْفَة كَانَتْ إِيهْ؟ لَمَّا الْمُقَابِلْ يِقُولْ لَكْ كِدَه، عَايِزْ يِسْمَعْ الْخَلْفِيَّة بِسُرْعَة، مِشْ قِصَّة طَوِيلَة. مِثَالْ: 'Give me the situation at the client meeting.'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي وَاحْدَة: 'Can you clarify that?' يَعْنِي... مُمْكِنْ تْوَضَّحْلي؟ لَمَّا مِشْ فَاهِمْ سُؤَالْ، مِتْخَمِّنْشْ... اسْأَلْ. مِثَالْ: 'Sorry, can you clarify what you mean by ownership?'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَالْتَة، وَهِيَ الْأَهَمْ: 'Let me walk you through it.' يَعْنِي... خَلِّينِي أْوَدِّيكْ خَطْوَة خَطْوَة. بِتَسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا تِشْرَحْ حَاجَة مُرَتَّبَة. مِثَالْ: 'Let me walk you through how we shipped it.'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَسْ خُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ غَلْطَة مَكَالْ... قَالْ: 'I live here since two years.' الْمُشْكِلَة إِنَّ فِي الْعَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ 'مِنْ سَنَتَيْن'، فَبِنْنَقْلْهَا زِي مَا هِيَ... لَكِنْ فِي الْإِنْجِلِيزِي، 'since' مَعَاهَا نُقْطَة بِدَايَة، مِشْ مُدَّة. يَعْنِي 'since 2022'، أَوْ 'for two years'.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: فَالشَّكْلْ الطَّبِيعِي: 'I have lived here for two years.' أَوْ 'I have been living here for two years.' خَدْ بِالَكْ... دَهْ مِشْ عَيْبْ، دَهْ عَادِي جِدًّا. يَلَّا، نِكَمِّلْ!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, Tarek, your turn. You always ask the hard questions. Let's see you answer one.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Fine. Give me the situation. Last year, our biggest client almost walked away because of a billing mistake.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: And your task?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: My task was to fix the relationship and keep the account. I called the client myself, admitted the error, and rebuilt the trust step by step. Let me walk you through it.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait. That was good. But you skipped the numbers again. What changed because of you?

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: We kept the account. Two million dirhams a year. But honestly, that is not the part I wanted to talk about tonight.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hey. What's going on? You've been off all week.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: My father is sick. Back in Cairo. My mother called me this morning and said he needs surgery. I have not told anyone at work yet.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Tarek. I have been living here for two years, and I know that feeling. You don't carry that alone. Tell me what you need.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: I don't know yet. But thanks. That actually helps.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Anytime. Now let me check my phone, my mother has been calling me three times.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Oh no. She just sent a voice note. She's coming to Dubai. Next week. And she thinks I already have the fellowship.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يا جَمَاعَة، نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَة... 'Give me the situation' يَعْنِي احْكِيلي الْوَقْفَة، وَ'Can you clarify that?' يَعْنِي وَضَّحْلي يا بَاشَا، وَ'Let me walk you through it' يَعْنِي خَلِّينِي أْوَدِّيكْ خَطْوَة خَطْوَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة، اهْتَمُّوا مَعَايَا... 'for two years' مِشْ 'since two years'. مِشْ 'since two years'! قُولْ: 'I have lived here for two years.'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبِالْمُنَاسَبَة... الْحَلْقَة دِي كَانَتْ عَنْ الصِّدْق، مِشْ بَسْ عَنْ الْإِنْجِلِيزِي. طَارِكْ فَتَحْ قَلْبُه، وَمَكَالْ سَمِعْ. دَهْ نَجَاحْ حَقِيقِي.
lines.direction: soft, sincere, proud of the characters

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَعَالُوا عَلَى تِلِجْرَامْ 'إِمْبَايَرْ إِنْجِلِيشْ كُومْيُونِيتِي'... اكْتُبُوا لِي جُمْلَة بِ 'for' أَوْ 'since'، وَأَنَا هَرُدْ عَلَيْكُمْ. وَاشْتَرِكُوا فِي الْبُودْكَاسْتْ عَشَانْ مِتْفَوِّتْشْ حَلْقَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالْمَرَّة الْجَايَة... أُمّ مَكَالْ وَاصْلَة دُبَيْ! وَمَكَالْ لِسَّه مَا خَدْشْ الْفِيلُوشِيبْ. يَا سَاتِرْ... يَلَّا، نِلْتَقِي بُكْرَة!
lines.direction: suspenseful tease, then warm goodbye, slight laugh
